canonical_name: Mergelyan uniform complex-polynomial approximation theorem family
literal_source_claim_zh: 紧集上连续函数的多项式逼近
literal_source_claim_en: Polynomial approximation of continuous functions on compact sets.
statement_blocker: The catalog gloss is not the standard true theorem statement: it omits the ambient complex plane, connected complement, holomorphicity on the compact set's interior, the function codomain, uniform error formulation, positive-error quantifier, polynomial evaluation encoding, and boundary cases. Secondary source leads recover the familiar family but are not an admitted primary-source crosswalk. Selecting an exact proposition at intake would add uncited proposition-changing clauses.
domain_and_universes: Open: an approved primary source must fix a compact subset of the complex plane, the complex-valued function representation, connectedness and holomorphicity predicates, polynomial encoding, universes, and coercions.
conclusion: Open: source-faithful uniform approximation on the selected compact set by complex polynomials, with exact error quantifiers and evaluation or norm representation unresolved.
degenerate_case_status: No case is excluded before a proposition is source-approved; statement work must resolve every case listed in scope-map.md.
candidate_scope_not_credited: epsilon approximation by p : Polynomial Complex for every function continuous on compact K and holomorphic on interior K when the plane complement is connected
density of complex polynomial restrictions in the algebra A(K)
existence of a sequence of complex polynomials converging uniformly on K
a no-holes formulation through holomorphic extension over bounded complement components
degenerate_cases_to_resolve: empty, singleton, finite, disconnected, and empty-interior compact sets
compact sets with and without holes
nonemptiness semantics of connected versus preconnected complement
constant and zero functions and constant polynomials
positive, zero, and negative approximation error
vacuity of holomorphicity on empty interior
pointwise epsilon, supremum norm, closure, density, and sequential formulations
excluded_substitutions: real Weierstrass approximation on a compact interval
complex Stone-Weierstrass after adjoining conjugation through star closure
disk-only, interval-only, Jordan-domain-only, finite-set, or other special cases
the false unrestricted claim obtained by omitting connected complement or interior holomorphicity
a structure or hypothesis storing the desired polynomial approximant
a numerical fit, theorem name, API check, or the untrusted verified label
